technique_name: Compose an essay about the pros and cons of the internet.
description: The internet is an amazing tool which has revolutionized our lives, but it also has negative effects. On the one hand, it has made the world a much smaller place with its ability to connect people from any corner of the globe. It has revolutionized the way we access and share information, giving us access to an incredible amount of knowledge. Additionally, it has enabled us to stay in contact with loved ones near and far.
